message.content:
Los Angeles (Pacific Time) is **9 hours behind** Berlin (Central European Time).  
During standard time:  

* Los Angeles – PST (UTC‑8)  
* Berlin – CET (UTC +1)  

Difference: 9 hours (Berlin ahead).

During daylight‑saving time:  

* Los Angeles – PDT (UTC‑7)  
* Berlin – CEST (UTC +2)  

Again, 9 hours (Berlin ahead).  

(There may be brief periods around the DST transition dates when the offset temporarily changes to 8 or 10 hours, but for most of the year it’s a consistent 9‑hour lead.)
